title: Woven bootstrap binaries are ~12.7x larger than plain builds (~20.4 MB overhead each)
claim: Weaving adds ~20.4 MB of static binary size per executable (woven ~22.1 MB vs plain ~1.75 MB). The observed woven build times were 6.410, 230.515, and 92.342 seconds; plain times were 1.314, 1.369, and 0.392 seconds. These are single observations on a shared machine, not representative benchmarks.
repro_command: cd <private-copy>/iast/database/sql/testapp && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go build -o /tmp/iast-bootstrap ./cmd/bootstrap && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go build -o /tmp/iast-bootstrap-plain ./cmd/bootstrap && wc -c /tmp/iast-bootstrap /tmp/iast-bootstrap-plain
